brief: Build a single-page website for 'KŌAN' — a fictional tea-ceremony experience studio in Kyoto. Required sections in order: (1) hero statement, (2) philosophy, (3) three experiences, (4) footer with location. Direction: dark, ceremonial, quiet motion. Must include scroll-linked motion and entrance animations. No external images, no external fonts, no frameworks — one self-contained index.html. Content must be original.

constraints.same_brief: this file — both arms build from this exact brief
constraints.same_gates: identical deterministic gate suite + originality comparator vs case-fe653973ef reference fingerprint

CONTROL.definition: Same model + brief, WITHOUT KINETIC: no DesignCase retrieval, no engine primitives, no tokens, no install receipts, no KINETIC-specific lessons applied. Generic best-practice hand-written HTML/CSS/JS only.
CONTROL.isolation_note: Honest limitation: the same agent builds both arms, so the model's general knowledge cannot be blinded. What IS isolated is the KINETIC SYSTEM — retrieval, primitives, recipes, tokens, receipts, and the corpus-derived originality/axis-inversion lessons are not used in the control arm. This is recorded as a validity caveat, not hidden.

TREATMENT.definition: Same model + brief, WITH KINETIC: retrieve relevant DesignCase from corpus, install primitives via engine installer, use tokens, record engine receipt.
TREATMENT.retrieval_expected: case-fe653973ef (IZANAMI) — nearest corpus case to a dark ceremonial tea-ceremony brief

hypothesis: KINETIC treatment will show (a) full traceability + reproducibility receipts the control lacks, (b) free reduced-motion compliance via primitives, (c) equal-or-better originality distance from the nearest reference thanks to the corpus-derived axis-inversion lesson. Cost: more build steps (install + receipt) than control.
uplift_rule: Do NOT claim uplift unless measured differences support it. Design quality is NOT compared here — this runtime is text-only; aesthetic judgment stays pending-vision-or-human for both arms.
